noun_definition: h1 test message refers to a message formatted as a header level 1 (H1) using a hash symbol (#) followed by text, which is being copied and pasted in a chat application.
Chat refers to the messaging interface where users can send and edit formatted messages, such as H1 messages, in the application described in the issue.
Line break refers to an unintended formatting change that occurs when pasting an H1 message, resulting in an additional line being added after the '#' character.
